## Before requesting review

- [ ] I worked on a branch, not directly on `main`
- [ ] **No secrets in this PR** — no passwords, API keys, camera credentials, IP addresses,
      network details, floor plans, camera locations, or student information
- [ ] I looked at the "Files changed" tab and every change there is one I meant to make
- [ ] No large binary files (video, datasets, model weights) are included
- [ ] My commit messages describe what changed
